query: How can we reduce incident resolution time?

per_column.name: incident_category
per_column.rationale: Categorizes incidents from short_description, giving a strong grouping axis to compare resolution time by type. Sample values (vpn, network_connectivity, database, email) match source text well.

per_column.name: affected_system
per_column.rationale: Adds a system-level axis somewhat correlated with incident_category but distinct enough to segment resolution time by infrastructure. Values are reasonable inferences (e.g. 'email system'->email_server), though some are inferred beyond explicit text.

per_column.name: failure_symptom
per_column.rationale: Symptom type is a genuinely new axis useful for diagnosing which failure modes take longest. Samples are sound readings ('Cannot connect to database'->cannot_connect), though 'Email system not working properly'->service_outage is a mild inference.

per_column.name: is_unassigned
per_column.rationale: Derivable from assigned_to; unassigned incidents plausibly resolve slower, so directly relevant to the query. Grounded in an existing column.

per_column.name: resolver_match
per_column.rationale: Comparison of assigned_to vs closed_by is plausibly relevant to handoffs affecting resolution time, but its exact meaning is opaque and the True/False split is not clearly warranted from samples; NULLs are acceptable.

per_column.name: is_open_unresolved
per_column.rationale: Derivable from state/closed_at; open unresolved cases are central to resolution-time analysis. Sample rows are closed and correctly flagged False.

per_column.name: caller_segment
per_column.rationale: Distinguishing end_user vs itil_automated (likely from caller_id/sys_updated_by) is a modestly useful segmentation for resolution time. Grounding is plausible but not directly verifiable from the provided samples.

judge.rationale: The added columns provide several genuine grouping axes (category, system, symptom, assignment/open status) that meaningfully support analyzing drivers of resolution time. affected_system partly overlaps incident_category and resolver_match is semantically opaque, lowering usefulness slightly. Values are sound extractions or warranted inferences from short_description and existing operational fields, with no clear hallucinations observed in the samples.
